findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: Is your paranoia a warning sign?
findings.reason: The linter reads the heading alone as a paragraph. It is a heading over two paragraphs, so it lands nothing.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The linter counts one "your" in a six-word heading. It is the heading asking the reader's own question, as the guide's other headings speak to the reader ("If you do get an answer").
